items.title: A weighting condition on a twisted object can be checked after an etale base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a gerbe/picture setup where a weighting is a collection of integers attached to the stabilizer data of an object over a field, the lemma says the numerical weighting inequalities are preserved reflected by an etale base change of the ground field: given the object over k and a finite separable extension k', the weights computed after base change equal the original ones, so being weighted is fpqc-etale local on the ground field. The retained proof is written: it unfolds the definition of the weights as the degrees of the stabilizer group action on the tangent space pieces, notes the degrees are computed by the characteristic polynomial of the grading element which is unchanged by the field extension (the computation is explicit in the proof), and reduces the inequalities to the already-computed equalities. Retained author proof at lines 22124-22149.
